name: Bush's purple-coneflower
desc: Bush's purple-coneflower (Echinacea paradoxa): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 22 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Echinacea paradoxa, the yellow coneflower, Bush's purple coneflower, or Ozark coneflower, is a North American species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae.
